subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview/sample first-run tour be adopted on top of current onboarding, narrowed into a smaller follow-up, or closed in favor of the merged onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: this PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping setup, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-gateway preservation, and fresh route proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the still-wanted sample/preview experience and leave setup-code and connection-path work to focused onboarding PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh as the maintained product direction if the preview-tour surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-gateway preservation, and fresh route proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct current-main ownership signal is the configured-gateway routing fix on the same startup decision surface.
